long.text: Learn to shape clay into something worth keeping, and build a small collection of my own finds in the house.
long.reason: Clay is good and so are things I have claimed, and I mean to have both in one place.

steps.reason: The restlessness needs running off before I settle, and dusk is the only time for it.
Something soft is there, and I have earned it after all that running.

today.reason: The day's making is used up, so I will keep to running and resting.
